correctness.rationale: Finite field GF(25) as F5[u]/(u²−2) is well-defined and the open-neighborhood face condition is exact. Exhaustive enumeration gives 93,350 nonempty faces. Every one of 43,546 deletions is checked as a free-face/codimension-one-coface pair. A further 2,967-pair matching is acyclic by complete directed-Hasse topological sort on 6,258 nodes/24,126 covers. Critical cells: 1 in dimension 0, 262 in dimension 3, 61 in dimension 4. Full signed Morse recurrence gives a 262×61 exact integral matrix with Smith invariants 1 (56 times) and 5 (once), implying H3=Z^205⊕Z/5 and H4=Z^4, zero otherwise reduced. Reconstructed matrix and independent direct simplicial mod-two/mod-five ranks agree. The code and matrix certificate are embedded and exact.

value.rationale: The natural square-field Paley graph is a highly symmetric 25-vertex conference graph. Its open-neighborhood topology displays order-five torsion in degree three and nonzero free homology one dimension higher; rational ranks, graph parameters and the previously calculated prime-field cases cannot determine this exact integral structure. The exact computation provides a substantive prime-primary finite benchmark, not a routine enumerated count or a universal pattern claim.
